Mitigation paths: (a) Optimizer turnover penalty (15bps × 723% = 108bps drag), (b) Forge S5 mutation buffer-zone widening (e.g., keep_n=25 + entry_n=20), (c) Forge S5 score smoothing (3M EWMA score). Alpha agent boundary stops here — Optimizer + Forge address actual deployment turnover.

Bailey-Lopez de Prado conservative DSR penalty would lower DSR proxy by ~3-4 SD units (still PASS at 7.6 → ~3.5).
